verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a company-incorporation service, so user-authored automations that can be versioned, reviewed, and rolled back fall outside its category. The evidence describes only vendor-run steps, such as Atlas automatically filing Form SS-4 and 83(b) elections. Those are fixed service actions, not user automations, so they do not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
